The examples on this page use the HERS data,
which the [Comparing Means](basic-statistical-methods.qmd#sec-hers-intro) page describes.
The `rmb` R package includes the dataset;
`haven::as_factor()` converts its Stata value labels to factors:

```{r}
#| label: load-hers
hers <- rmb::hers |> haven::as_factor()
```
